resolution.note: regression tests in test/hook/stop-lane-branch.test.ts fail on origin/main and pass with the single lane-record resolution in src/hook/stop.ts

title: The Stop check resolves a lane's branch to another worktree
body:
Source: lead session 2026-11-16: a krn-lane subagent that shipped two PRs from two worktrees (pending-edit-archived #1218, pending-edit-published #1222) had its final report refused by the Stop check, which named branch outdated-instructions (the lead's own worktree) as the lane branch; two other lanes reported the Stop hook 'checked the main repository' and saw no commit.
Outcome: the Stop check resolves a subagent lane's branches from the worktrees that lane started (its krn lane start records), accepts a report naming any of them, and never resolves to another lane's or the lead's worktree; a test covers a lane with two worktrees.
Proof: node --test test/hook/stop-lane-branch.test.ts: pass
Files: src/hook/, scripts/claude/
